about: One Devin session growing in stages, replayed by both search index writers: tests/test_search_harnesses.py (DevinChainFixtureTests) and app/mac/Tests/SWECoreTests/SearchDevinTests.swift (sharedFixtureGrowsTheSameRowsAsSwe). After each stage's SQL runs against sessions.db, one pass must leave exactly this files row, session row, message rows and meta mark (null: no mark); {ino} is the database's inode and {session} the session row's id. same_session says whether the stage appended to the previous stage's session (true) or read the chain whole into a new one (false). A second pass right after must index nothing.

stages.note: first read: the whole chain, the streamed copy at node 2 off it
